author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I can't taste the difference between a $200 bottle wine vs a $2000 bottle wine, so the $200 wine is good enough for me

If you can't tell the difference between AI generated stuff vs human hand crafted stuff, then AI generated stuff is good enough for you.

author.name: Jarmo Venalainen
author.headline: Studying what AI is, what it can do and what it will do.

comments.text:
For me AI is fast at mixing up quasi-random recepies based on a corpus of what people have and have not liked, so,

Some of it's muffins are really delicious,

but,

Most of them are like industrially produced white bread.

That raises the question, if a human artist chooses the tasty one during his chat, as per his unique taste, is that original art?

Further reading:
https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jarmo-venalainen-abb61810_for-me-ai-is-fast-at-mixing-up-quasi-random-activity-7474560098053345280-ZAtc?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_ios&rcm=ACoAAAI6FS8B2DkdOJhcLufZjc3FZM-WfUEVOfY
